v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.la: Dele iniquitátem meam, * Dómine, secúndum multitúdinem miseratiónum tuárum.
text.en: According to the multitude of thy tender mercies * blot out my iniquity.

text.la: Discérne causam meam, * Deus, de gente non sancta.
text.en: Distinguish my cause, O Lord, * from the nation that is not holy.

text.la: Deus misereátur * nostri, et benedícat nobis. ‡
text.en: May God have mercy on us * and bless us. ‡

text.la: Corrípies me, Dómine, * et vivificábis me.
text.en: Thou shalt correct me, O Lord, * and make me to live.

text.la: Laudáte * Dóminum quia benígnus est, et in servis suis deprecábitur.
text.en: Praise * the Lord, for he will judge his people, and be gracious unto his servants.

text.la: Veníte, et ascendámus ad montem Dómini, et ad domum Dei Iacob, et docébit nos vias suas, et ambulábimus in sémitis eius: quia de Sion exíbit lex, et verbum Dómini de Ierúsalem.
text.en: Come and let us go up to the mountain of the Lord, and to the house of the God of Jacob, and he will teach us his ways, and we will walk in his paths: for the law shall come forth from Sion, and the word of the Lord from Jerusalem.

v.la: Vox clamántis in desérto: Paráte viam Dómini.
v.en: A voice of one crying in the wilderness: Prepare the way of the Lord.

text.la: Antequam convenírent, * invénta est María habens in útero de Spíritu Sancto, allelúia.
text.en: Before they came together, * Mary was found with child of the Holy Ghost. Alleluia.

text.la: Excita, quǽsumus, Dómine, poténtiam tuam, et veni: ut ab imminéntibus peccatórum nostrórum perículis, te mereámur protegénte éripi, te liberánte salvári:
text.en: Stir up, O Lord, we pray thee, thy strength, and come among us, that whereas through our sins and wickedness we do justly apprehend thy wrathful judgments hanging over us, thy bountiful grace and mercy may speedily help and deliver us;

text.la: Euge, serve bone et fidélis, quia in pauca fuísti fidélis, supra multa te constítuam, intra in gáudium Dómini tui.
text.en: Well done, thou good and faithful servant; thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things; enter thou into the joy of thy Lord.

v.la: Iustum dedúxit Dóminus per vias rectas.
v.en: The Lord guided the just in right paths.

r.en: And showed him the kingdom of God.

text.la: Intercéssio nos, quǽsumus, Dómine, beáti Sabbæ Abbátis comméndet: ut, quod nostris méritis non valémus, eius patrocínio assequámur.
text.en: May the pleading of blessed Sabbas, the Abbot, make us acceptable unto thee, O Lord, we pray; that what we may not have through any merits of ours, we may gain by means of his patronage.

office.title: Feria III infra Hebd I Adventus
